posts.name: CelitePro
posts.tagline: Professional Videos. Made Simple.
posts.description: CelitePro introduces a new approach to professional video creation by combining complex multi-layer templates, intelligent content-to-layer mapping, automated workflows, and cloud rendering. Users simply upload their content, while CelitePro maps it to the correct template layers and delivers the final video without requiring high-end hardware or advanced editing skills. It also focuses on regional templates, consistent output, and low-cost video production.

posts.name: Patronus Scanner
posts.tagline: API to scan AI inputs for prompt injection and data leaks
posts.description: Patronus Scanner is a security API for AI apps and agents. Scan text, public URLs, files and MCP servers for prompt injection and data leakage before content reaches your model. Integrate via REST, SDKs, CLI, Remote MCP or native agent plugins.

posts.name: Klinky
posts.tagline: Split one link between two destinations.
posts.description: Klinky lets you split traffic between two destinations using one shared link. Keep the current page live, send a controlled share to a new landing page, workflow, checkout, or offer, and compare downstream results in your existing analytics. No code, no install, and free while Klinky is early.

posts.name: Focus
posts.tagline: Reclaim your time
posts.description: Focus is a free minimalist launcher for Android: a text-only, black and white home screen with built-in app timers and a weekly screen time review. 1.3 MB, no ads, no internet permission.

posts.name: Marksmith Forge
posts.tagline: Private Markdown editor for Windows with native DOCX & PDF
posts.description: Marksmith Forge is a free, local-first Markdown editor for Windows with live preview, full Mermaid diagram support, math, focus tools, themes, and native PDF, DOCX, HTML, EPUB, and LaTeX export. No account, cloud backend, analytics, Pandoc, Office, Python, or TeX required.

posts.name: Propcinity
posts.tagline: Find the right property. Not just listings.
posts.description: Propcinity is a real estate decision intelligence platform that helps you choose the right property—not scroll through hundreds of listings. Tell us your budget, location, purpose, and requirements. Propcinity matches you with relevant properties and helps you evaluate them using AI-powered matching, Match Scores, property comparisons, and AI assistance. 🏠 Matched properties 🎯 Match Scores ⚖️ Side-by-side comparison 🤖 AI assistance 🔎 Smarter property research

posts.name: MagicSheet
posts.tagline: Blazing fast AI decisions across thousands of rows
posts.description: MagicSheet turns repetitive human judgment into a spreadsheet operation. Upload a CSV, describe what you want AI to decide, and process thousands of rows at once — from search query classification to lead scoring, tagging, and text analysis.

posts.name: bloom
posts.tagline: Your all-in-one AI study companion
posts.description: Bloom is an AI-powered study app that brings active recall, AI tutoring, notes, flashcards, study tools and progress tracking into one place. Instead of jumping between different study apps, Bloom brings the tools you actually use together in one study experience.

posts.name: Wapas
posts.tagline: Everything finds its way back.
posts.description: Lost your wallet? Found someone's keys? Wapas connects the two of you with verified claims, private contact, and a handover you can prove.

posts.name: Loopdraw
posts.tagline: The PDF editor that edits the actual text
posts.description: Loopdraw is a free online PDF editor. Edit the words on the page in the document’s own type. Sign it, draw on it, reorder it, convert it. Most of it runs in your browser.

posts.name: S2CSV
posts.tagline: Ecommerce catalog & collection exporter to CSV
posts.description: Extract full Shopify and WooCommerce product catalogs, collections, multi-variants, and high-res images directly into official Shopify or WooCommerce CSV import templates in seconds.

posts.name: Signal
posts.tagline: Build your visibility. Create better content.
posts.description: Signal helps businesses improve their online visibility and get discovered by both Google and AI-powered search engines. Analyze your website visibility, discover competitors, identify content gaps, and generate platform-native content tailored to your brand. Signal also connects businesses with real creators, from Reels editors to LinkedIn ghostwriters, who can turn content ideas into publish-ready work. Build your visibility. Create better content. Get discovered.

posts.name: QR Code Pro
posts.tagline: Free QR codes: links, Wi-Fi, contacts, email. No account.
posts.description: QR Code Pro makes a QR code in seconds, on your phone, with nothing to sign up for. Pick a type — link, plain text, Wi-Fi network, contact card (vCard) or pre-filled email — fill in the fields, and the code appears instantly. Change its colors and pattern, save it to Photos or share it straight from the app. Free, no account, no subscription. A one-time Pro unlock (€2.99) removes the watermark and the ads and lifts the history limit. Built by an indie developer in France, in French and English.

posts.name: CoachForge AI
posts.tagline: Build personalized workout programs in minutes, not hours.
posts.description: CoachForge AI helps online fitness coaches turn client goals, experience, equipment and limitations into structured, editable multi-week workout programs. Your first program is free.

posts.name: Octopus
posts.tagline: Tracked document links with page-level analytics
posts.description: Octopus turns any document into a tracked link with page-by-page analytics and secure data rooms. See who opened it, which pages they read, and how engaged they are, then control access with email gates, watermarks and expiry. Flat-rate, unlimited, free plan to start.

posts.name: Poor 2 Power: Tycoon Simulator
posts.tagline: Build, manage, upgrade & trade across 24 business levels!
posts.description: Business Empire is an interactive business simulation game where you build your journey from a small shop to a powerful business empire. Unlock and manage 24+ unique businesses, upgrade your operations, increase your income, complete challenges, and grow your virtual wealth. Make strategic decisions, expand your businesses, and discover new opportunities as you progress. 🚀💰

posts.name: Webdesly Habits
posts.tagline: A calm habit journal with grace days — not streak anxiety
posts.description: Webdesly Habits is a web-first habit journal. Check in by morning, afternoon, and evening. Track habit strength that recovers. Use grace days when life intervenes. Optional one-line notes turn check-ins into reflection.

posts.name: ShowVision
posts.tagline: Track TV shows, episodes, and return dates.
posts.description: ShowVision keeps TV and anime release dates in one place. Track shows without signing up, see next episodes and returning seasons in a personal watchlist and calendar, and tell confirmed dates from clearly labeled estimates. Built for the one question every fan asks: what comes back next?

posts.name: PostGuard for Reddit
posts.tagline: Know if your Reddit post will stay up — before you post
posts.description: PostGuard scores your Reddit draft against the subreddit's rules, your karma and account age — then keeps checking from a signed-out view after you publish, to catch the removals nobody tells you about. It never posts, votes or comments for you.
